purpose: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define import as a recursive non-executable command family whose concrete descendants validate inert external/file data before any explicit canonical application operation. [2] Define `import` as the symmetric recursive non-executable namespace for concrete import subcommands and file/modality-specific profiles.

does_not_own: domain semantics outside explicit command targets

value.application_rule: Import does not mutate canonical/runtime state until an explicit validated target operation applies the data.
value.authority_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Imported content cannot grant authority or select arbitrary roots/commands. [2] Import availability does not grant target mutation authority.
value.concrete_rule: Only explicit concrete descendants may cross the canonical change boundary.
value.failure_rule: Unknown format/subcommand fails explicitly rather than falling back to fuzzy format detection.
value.inert_rule: Imported data remains inert after parsing/format decoding.
value.path_rule: Source filename/path does not become semantic identity.
value.profile_rule: Each concrete importer declares its accepted format/profile and semantic target type.
value.recursive_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] import may contain modality/category families and concrete format commands recursively. [2] Concrete import commands may exist under nested subfamilies such as `import.files.json`.
value.root_rule: `import` is a namespace/family root, not an executable operation by itself.
value.symmetry_rule: Import/export families follow the same recursive namespace/help rules.
value.validation_rule: Concrete import command declares input format, schema/identity expectations and target semantics.
